description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific upgrade processes for the Redboot FIS format, including image validation and upgrade procedures involving tar and mtd tools.

methods.name: platform_check_image_redboot_fis
methods.description: Checks if the given image file has the expected magic word for Redboot FIS images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_redboot_fis
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by extracting kernel and root filesystem from the provided image using tar and writing it to flash using mtd commands.
